notes.title: Release of the OpenXR Version of the Game
notes.notes:
Experimental OpenXR version of game added
Cross-Platform Compatibility: Enjoy seamless gameplay across various VR and AR devices

Why OpenXR?

OpenXR is an open standard that provides high-performance access to VR and AR platforms and devices. By adopting OpenXR, we ensure that our game is accessible to a wider audience and delivers a top-notch gaming experience regardless of the hardware you use.
